theme_cn: 作文跟读 + 阅读理解 + 代词语法 + 听力 + 键盘拼写
spell_name: 阅读里的重点词，敲一遍

reading.passage: Shadow puppetry is an old Chinese art that is more than 2,000 years old. The puppets are made of thin leather, and workers cut and colour them by hand. Behind a white cloth screen, a lamp shines and makes the puppets' shadows dance. The puppeteer pulls small sticks and sings the story at the same time. One person can move three or four puppets and speak for all of them. In 2011 this art became a world treasure, and now some primary schools teach it in art classes.
reading.passage_cn: 皮影戏是一门古老的中国艺术，已经有两千多年历史。皮影是用薄薄的皮革做的，工人用手工剪刻并上色。在一块白布后面，一盏灯照着，让皮影的影子跳起舞来。演皮影的人一边拉动小棍子，一边唱故事。一个人能同时操纵三四个皮影，还能替它们说话。二零一一年这门艺术成为世界级的宝贝，现在一些小学在美术课上教它。

questions.question: What are the puppets made of?
questions.explanation_cn: 第二句说 The puppets are made of thin leather（用薄皮革做的），白布只是幕布（screen）。

questions.question: What makes the shadows dance on the screen?
questions.explanation_cn: 第三句说 Behind a white cloth screen, a lamp shines（幕布后面有一盏灯照着），才有影子。

questions.question: How many puppets can one puppeteer move at the same time?
questions.explanation_cn: 第五句写 One person can move three or four puppets（一个人能操纵三四个皮影）。

grammar.question: 用括号里代词的适当形式填空：This is ___ (I) mother.
grammar.explanation_cn: I 是主格「我」，这里要说「我的」妈妈，用形容词性物主代词 my。

grammar.question: 用括号里代词的适当形式填空：Look at these flowers. ___ (them) are beautiful.
grammar.explanation_cn: 空里缺的是主语，要用主格；them 是宾格，主格是 they，句首在屏幕上会自动大写，答案敲小写 they 就行。

grammar.question: 用括号里代词的适当形式填空：Please pass ___ (he) a book to read.
grammar.explanation_cn: 动词 pass 后面的人要用宾格，he 的宾格是 him：pass him a book 递给他一本书。

grammar.question: 用括号里代词的适当形式填空：This cat is not ___ (me); it is Lucy's.
grammar.explanation_cn: 后面没有名词，要单独用名词性物主代词 mine = my cat。me 是宾格，不能当「我的」用。

grammar.question: 用括号里代词的适当形式填空：You cannot leave him alone; he is too young to stay with ___ (he).
grammar.explanation_cn: 他自己陪他自己 → 反身代词 himself。主语是 he，反身代词用 himself。

grammar.question: 用括号里代词的适当形式填空：Miss White is my English teacher; I am ___ (she) student.
grammar.explanation_cn: 「她的学生」，名词前面用形容词性物主代词 her。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. When does the puppet show start?
listening.audio_text: Girl: Dad, when does the shadow puppet show start? Dad: It starts at half past seven, so we should leave home at six. Girl: Great, I will finish my homework first.
listening.explanation_cn: 爸爸说 It starts at half past seven（七点半开始）；六点是出门的时间，别混。

listening.question: Which picture matches the sentence you hear?
listening.audio_text: The old man is pulling a small stick behind the white screen.
listening.explanation_cn: 句子里说的是 white screen（白幕）和老人在幕后拉小棍，是皮影戏，所以选 🎭。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: The puppets are made of thin ___.
listening.audio_text: The puppets are made of thin leather, and they are cut by hand.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到 The puppets are made of thin leather（薄皮革），所以填 leather。

spell.question: 购物：s_______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: shopping 双写 p 再加 ing：shop → shopping，本周作文第一句就是它。

spell.question: 出租车：t___ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: taxi 读 /ˈtæksi/，三个音都很短，take a taxi 打车。

spell.question: 他自己的：h_______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: him + self，反身代词；她自己用 herself，我自己用 myself。

writing_drill.title: 第 3~5 句 · 时间与交通
writing_drill.focus_cn: Is 10 o'clock OK? 注意语调上扬；take a taxi 是打车

sentences.blank_cn: 问句开头的「是」（敲小写就行）

sentences.en: Then we can take a taxi.
sentences.cn: 然后我们可以打出租车去。

sentences.en: I want to buy new football boots and some pairs of socks.
sentences.cn: 我想买新足球鞋和几双袜子。
